title: Application of Various Low Energy Electron Microscopy, LEEM Techniques to Quantum Materials
content: Low Energy Electron Microscopy (LEEM) was invented in 1962, and the technique has been slowly developed over the last sixty years and now includes other analytical techniques, PEEM, REELS, APRES and LEED. Most importantly LEEM with aberration corrected optics is now possible which opens up a whole new range of imaging possibilities. LEEM is a pure surface technique and we have applied LEEM techniques to a variety of material analytical problems.
